tutorial.welcome_description: Here you can securely create and register your passwords.
tutorial.page_subtitle: Security and convenience in one place
tutorial.security_description: Your passwords will be stored exclusively on your device, protected by robust encryption.
tutorial.app_password_description: To access and use the application, authorize the use of your smartphone's default password by clicking the button below.
tutorial.required_step_message: This step is required to access the application
tutorial.info_description:
This application was developed to provide security and convenience in storing your passwords.

All information is stored exclusively on your device and is never shared.
tutorial.no_personal_info: We do not collect personal information
tutorial.privacy_focused: Developed with a focus on your privacy
tutorial.privacy_policy_intro: Please review the key expectations for storing sensitive passwords with PassVault.
tutorial.privacy_policy_acceptance_description: By continuing you confirm you own the credentials you will store, will use PassVault only for lawful purposes, and understand it is a personal vault for your accounts.
tutorial.privacy_policy_responsible_use_descripti: Keep your device protected with a strong unlock method, do not share your biometric data or PIN, and avoid saving sensitive data on shared devices you do not control.
tutorial.privacy_policy_security_description: PassVault keeps your information encrypted and stored only on this device. Make regular encrypted backups and keep your operating system updated to avoid data loss.
tutorial.privacy_policy_liability_description: The PassVault team is not responsible for damages caused by improper use, weak passwords, lost or compromised devices, or missing backups. You remain accountable for the content you store.
tutorial.privacy_policy_updates_description: We may update this policy and the app. We will announce relevant changes within the app. For questions, contact support through the link in the settings.
tutorial.privacy_policy_acknowledgement: I have read and understand the privacy policy above.
tutorial.privacy_policy_acceptance_required: You need to accept the privacy policy to continue using PassVault.
